batting.name: CH Gayle
batting.dismissal: c DA Miller b Azhar Mahmood

batting.name: AB de Villiers
batting.dismissal: c PP Chawla b Azhar Mahmood

batting.name: AB McDonald
batting.dismissal: c N Saini b Azhar Mahmood

batting.name: N Saini
batting.dismissal: c DL Vettori b AB McDonald

batting.name: DJ Hussey
batting.dismissal: run out (R Vinay Kumar, AB de Villiers)

batting.name: Azhar Mahmood
batting.dismissal: run out (KP Appanna, AB de Villiers)

balls.text: in the blockhole to finish, Pathan digs it out through the leg side, just the single, four runs and two wickets off that final over
a loopy slower ball outside off, bowled on a full length, the batsman heaved far too early
that's a harsh call, the ball was full and just inside the tram line outside off stump, the batsman had backed away towards leg as well
full and straight, Tiwary can only drive to long-on
would you believe it, AB has swatted a full toss straight to mid-on, Mahmood's got away with that one
Asad Pathan dabs his first ball of IPL 2012 close on the off side and runs, that was in the blockhole

edged and caught behind! Mahmood delivered a full ball outside off, McDonald backed away and tried to hit through the off side, he got a thick edge through to Saini. A dot ball and AB stays off strike
that's been slashed for six over third man! AB backed away against a short of a length ball and swung hard, placing the ball wide of third man and into the Kings XI dugout
good length outside off, McDonald backs away and hits towards cover
AB backs away but Awana follows him, he mis-times the pull on the leg side
full and straight, McDonald stays in his crease and drives to long off
the short ball is too high, so that's a wide
McDonald backs away to smash a length ball on the off side but gets a thick edge past the keeper for four
McDonald tries to pull a short ball but gets beaten
a full toss and the batsman swats it to long off
driven on the front foot to the fielder at cover
AB swings off the front foot, hitting the ball with a golf swing towards long-on
driven on the front foot to long off
AB reverse-hits the ball to cover
in the blockhole around off stump, the batsman jams his bat down but gets an edge past the keeper
driven off the front foot to point
pushed off the front foot towards cover point
bowled him! Kohli goes back to pull the ball, it's the quicker delivery that skids into the right-hander, the ball hits Kolhi's pad and takes out off stump
AB mistimes the cut off the back foot through point
AB unfurls the reverse hit and smacks the ball flat through backward point
AB steps out, isn't to the pitch of the ball, and defends
AB steps out of his crease again and cuts the ball in front of point. Time-out is being taken
the short ball and AB pulls towards deep square leg where Chawla has to cover some ground to field
AB charges and cuts a length ball hard, doesn't beat Mandeep at point
good length close to off stump, AB stays in his crease, prods, and is beaten

Gayle attempts to hook a short delivery but he hasn't hit it well, he was cramped for room and top edged the ball high towards deep square leg, it's Miller under the ball again and this time he is well balanced and takes the catch. The drop has cost Kings XI 32 runs
there's a long-on in place and he only has to run a few metres to his right to stop the ball but he can't, that's because Gayle has smashed it, flat and very hard
another full ball, Gayle can't get under it and drives to long-on, Hussey's bowled a tight over
bowled flat and fast, Gayle plays it back to the bowler
Kohli makes some room and drives inside out towards long-off
in the blockhole once again, Gayle stays in his crease and hits towards long-on
played off the back foot towards wide long-on
bowled into the blockhole from round the wicket, Gayle digs it out on the leg side
now he slogs across the line and hits the ball along the ground through midwicket
that is the highest six I have seen. Gayle went on the back foot and heaved with all his immense might, carting a length ball into orbit over the bowler's head. That ball has cleared the roof
Kohli tries to play the big drive but edges to third man
good length and straight, Gayle stays back and opens the face to steer to point
steered towards third man for a single
Kohli has welcomed Nayar into the attack by stepping out and lofting a length ball over long-off, hit that cleanly with a full swing of the bat
he's making Punjab pay dearly for that drop now, he's charged the bowler and smashed him flat over long-on
that ball was only a few yards to third man's left but the fielder had no chance, Gayle cut the short of a length ball ferociously, he brings up his fifty with that shot
too full and too straight, poor line when fine leg is in the circle, Gayle stays in his crease and glances off his pads to the boundary
Kohl stands in his crease and hits the ball hard towards mid-off
Gayle goes back and pulls through square leg
Awana responds with a sharp bouncer but it is a bit high

Gayle has been dropped by the substitute David Miller. Gayle was squared up and tried to flat-bat the ball, he ended up slicing it in the air towards wide mid-off, slightly beyond the circle. Miller ran in from long off and to his right, he got to the ball well in time but let it go through his hands
he cuts hard again, but doesn't beat point this time
cut hard off the back foot to deep point
Kohli finally breaks free, stepping out to the ball and hitting through the line even though he was not to the pitch of the ball, he slams that far over long on
Gayle closes the face of the bat against the googly and gets a leading edge in front of point
Kohli cuts from his crease towards point
Gayle begins to come down the pitch and Chawla fires it full and fast down leg side, the keeper can't collect properly
that's short again, and you have to be lucky to escape punishment with that length against Gayle, he rocks back and heaves over the wide long-on boundary
a full toss but Gayle had gone back in his crease and couldn't hit with as much power as he would have liked, he ended up swatting it along the ground through midwicket
Kohli steps out and hits the length ball to long-on
Gayle stays back to a fuller ball and tries to cut, gets a bottom edge into the ground
Gayle charges and swings but gets beaten, that was the slower ball outside off
played firmly towards deep backward square where the fielder from fine leg runs to his right and slides to stop the ball with his legs
good length on off stump, hit hard off the back foot to cover
Kohli stays back and cuts to the fielder at point
good length outside off, Kohli tries to cut but gets a bottom edge
tossed up fuller outside off, Kohli plays the ball to cover
too short once again, Kohli pulls this time, along the ground and into the gap on the midwicket boundary, Chawla needs to sort his length out
flat and fuller, Gayle moves back and nudges in front of square
short ball first up and Gayle launches his first six, heaving across the line to send the ball into the stands beyond deep midwicket
that's a bit short and Gayle pulls with power, testing the fielder's slide at deep midwicket. The umpire signals for the time-out
good length on off stump, Kohli taps the ball towards the leg side and runs
played from the crease towards point
Kohli comes forward, makes room and drives hard, but can't beat cover
Gayle plays a flashy cut, from off stump, hitting the ball hard and inducing a mis-field from the fielder at point, there's protection in the deep though
good length angling into the right-hander, Kohli stays in his crease and plays towards mid-on
length ball outside off, Kohli opens the face of the bat and steers to third man
Kohli tries to pull a short of a length ball but misses and gets hit on the back
full length outside off, Kohli comes on to the front foot to drive but can't beat cover
Gayle makes room but Awana cramps him, Gayle ends up swatting the ball through cover
slapped off the back foot towards mid off
edged and four! Kohli comes half forward and pokes at a good length ball that straightens off the pitch, he gets an outside edge to the third man boundary. There was no slip
Kohli moves back and mis-times the push towards mid-on
Praveen pitches leg and seams it towards off, Gayle gets squared up as he pushes towards cover
Gayle shaped up to pull but saw the ball seaming across him and played the cut instead
pushed towards cover point for a single
Gayle stays back and drives towards long-off, not timed well
good length with big movement away from the left-hander, Gayle lets it go to the keeper standing up to the stumps
short of a length on the pads, Gayle stays back and flicks the ball through square leg
Kohli drives to mid-off for a single
short of a length ball but the line is too straight, Gayle pulls with power but can't beat short fine leg, Nayar throws at the non-striker's end and hits Gayle on the shoulder
Gayle stays in his crease and prods at a good length ball that bounces at lively pace just outside off stump, he was looking to steer that behind point but got beaten
short of a length outside off, Kohli stays back and opens the face to steer to third man
length ball with width outside off, Kohli stands in his crease and slaps the ball hard through the gap at cover
pushed off the front foot close on the off side, Gayle responds to Kohli's call, Praveen's pulled it back for Punjab after that 14-run over from Harris
that pitches on a good length around off and middle and straightens, Kohli stays back and defends on the off side
Kohli tries to flick one that angles into him but doesn't make proper contact
good length, cutting into Kohli, who tries to play on the leg side and does so unconvincingly
a full ball swings into Kohli, who stays in his crease and defends on the leg side
fuller ball on off and middle, Kohli leans forward and drives to mid-on
he's hit this well, a short ball and Gayle pulls that powerfully through midwicket, Royal Challngers are away
Gayle swings hard again, aiming to hit down the ground. That shot does not come off but the ball flies off the outside edge over point and to the boundary
Gayle finally gets going by muscling a full ball swinging into him through midwicket
pushed towards mid-off for a single
straighter line and Gayle plays the ball to square leg, he dropped his bat as he began to ground it and a direct hit at the non-striker's end would have dismissed Gayle
full length, pitching round off and slanting away from the left-hander, Gayle tries to play the big booming off drive but is beaten
played from the crease tentatively towards point
Praveen's got the ball on a string here, he pitches on a length and swings it away from the right-hander this time, Kohli stays back, fishes outside off and is beaten
Gayle stays put in his crease and steers the ball with the extravagant swing across him towards third man
Gayle gets squared up and beaten by a fuller ball that swings away from him sharply
pitches in line with the stumps on a good length and seams it away from the left-hander, Gayle stays back and lets the ball go
good length angling into Kohli, who stays in his crease and taps in front of square
full ball on leg stump, Gayle tries to play square but misses and is hit on the pad
pushed towards wide mid-off for a single, the crowd are roaring because Gayle has been given the strike for the first time today
good length outside off, Kohli lets it go

that is some reply from Harris, he has detonated off stump from the ground. Harris pitched on a good length around middle stump, Agarwal tried to hit down the ground without moving his feet, he had to lunge and reach for the ball. Harris seamed the ball away from the right-hander and Agarwal ended up playing down the wrong line. The ball hit the top of off stump and sent it cartwheeling
played from the crease on the off side
and he's been given a rousing welcome, Agarwal makes room by moving towards leg and throws his bat at a full ball, slicing it high and over the point boundary
good length and straight, Agarwal drops the ball close on the off side and sprints the single
Agarwal tries to close the face to play on the leg side, the ball swings away from him after pitching middle and the leading edge goes towards mid-off
Agarwal moves slightly forward and tries to drive straight, the ball beats the outside edge and just misses off stump, that pitched on a good length and moved slightly away
there's bounce too! The ball lifts from a length outside off, Agarwal tries to cut but is beaten by the extra bounce
this one moves away from the right-hander, Agarwal moves forward and pushes towards point
big inswing for Praveen, nipping the ball into the right-hander from a good length, Agarwal defends from the crease

Chawla's won the game! He's slammed a length ball angling into him high and far over long on with a powerful swing of the bat, there's so much relief in that Kings XI dug out. They were on the verge of victory and then got into an awful mess with poor running
short of a length and Dogra swivels and pulls to the fielder on the square leg boundary
full ball outside off stump, Dogra drives and finally gets it off the pitch, he's hit it through cover and the fielder from the sweeper boundary runs to his right to field
dropped but a dot ball, Dogra drives the ball hard and straight right back at the bowler, Vinay can't take it, a tough chance, that was hit hard
Dogra tries to hit through the off side but mis-hits it on the off side, will they run? no they don't. The crowd is right behind their team
Chawla slogs at the final ball and gets a bottom edge into the ground to AB, they don't run.

a third run out, all hell is breaking loose! Dogra dropped the ball close on the off side and ran for a non-existent single, Nayar responded. Kohli sprinted in from cover and picked up, he continued running towards the striker's end and once he got close enough he under-armed the ball into the stumps

what's going on? Hussey's been run out! He pulled the short of a length ball towards long leg and ran the single, he then sprinted back for the second and dived full length, there was no second run there. The throw from Vinay wasn't the best but AB moved in front of the stumps to collect and then whipped around to break them
good length from round the wicket on off and middle stump, played back to the bowler, the Chinnaswamy roars the dot ball, and then begins to chant their team's name
played towards point for a quick single, Hussey was desperate to get on strike
Zaheer hits the pads with one that angles into the left-hander, no runs
driven towards cover
nudged off the front foot towards point

a run out! Mahmood steps out of his crease and cuts to deep point, he wants the second and runs hard for it, the throw from the deep from Appanna is right over the bails and AB takes them off with the bat just short
Hussey bottom edges the cut into the ground and runs a quick single
nudged off the front foot in front of point
driven on the front foot towards long off
pushed off the front foot to cover, Hussey wanted one, Mahmood did not
good length around off, played from the crease towards backward point
worked off the pads in front of square
good length on off stump, defended on the off side
Saini's holed out, he was trying to launch a good length ball over the leg side but ended up slicing it in the air past the bowler, Vettori ran across from mid-on (I think) and took the catch
good length outside off, Saini tries to steer to third man but misses
that's a long hop, Hussey rocks back and pulls, watch out in the first tier beyond the midwicket boundary, it's coming your way
driven on the front foot to long off, that Saini's maiden fifty and it looks like a match-winning one
Pathan's beaten Saini with a lovely, flighted legbreak, Saini was lunging on the front foot, but his back foot was grounded when AB broke the stumps
cut off the back foot in front of point
Hussey pushes off the front foot and gets an edge behind point
Asad Pathan's first attempt at bowling legbreaks has disappeared over the straight boundary, Hussey got under a full ball and hammered it
short ball and Saini has smacked that, swivelling and pulling with power in front of the fielder on the square leg boundary
awkwardly played towards the off side, Kohli swoops on the ball from cover and scores a direct hit but Saini is safe
worked off the pads through square leg, that was played gently so they could come back for the second before the fielders in the deep got to the ball
Saini backs away but Zaheer follows him, tapped towards midwicket
Hussey stays in his crease  and cuts the good length ball to third man
length ball from round the wicket, Saini steps out and square drives through cover point, these two have now added 50
front on the front foot on the up through cover point
good length on off stump yet again, Hussey stays in his crease and pushes in front of point
stays on the back foot and dabs the good length ball from off stump towards point
good length with some extra bounce outside off, Saini comes forward to play on the off side but is beaten
fuller and straighter, Saini drives to mid-off
short and wide outside off, a hit-me-please ball, Saini stands tall on the back foot and cuts the ball over point
played towards point once again
quicker and flatter ball, cut off the back foot towards point
he's gone over long-off again, but has he hit it far enough? Kohli's on the boundary and he lunges backwards but in vain, the ball clears him
long off has no chance this time, Hussey's made room again and swung hard, smashing the ball far over the boundary
tossed up, Hussey moves towards leg to make room and clubs the ball straight past the bowler, long on has no chance
width outside off stump, Saini goes back and cuts to deep point
driven back to the bowler
played off the pads through square leg
Saini charges and and throws his bat at a ball outside off stump, mis-hitting it over point
played through wide mid-on for a single
played towards cover
Hussey lofts the ball in the air towards wide long-on, it's in the air for a while but Asad Pathan cannot run quickly enough to get to it, the ball bounces past him and goes for four
hit off the back foot through cover
driven to cover where Zaheer fumbles and deflects the ball towards mid-off
he's threaded the ball through the gap between backward point and short third man, used the width outside off and cut it late off the back foot
Saini steps out of his crease and hits the ball flat and in the air past the bowler, who dived to his left, the ball went to long off
driven off the front foot through cover
the batsman drives at a ball skidding into him and places it through point
driven to long off for a single
pushed from the crease through cover
bowled full on off stump, flat trajectory, Hussey defends on the front foot
nudged off the front foot in front of square
played through backward point for two more
driven off the front foot towards point, a direct hit from Appanna would have had the batsman running to the non-striker's end, but he misses and concedes an overthrow
full and straight, driven back to the bowler

lbw! Mandeep moved across his stumps, got down on one knee and tried to sweep. The ball was very straight and it hit him plumb in front. Vettori had just moved the fielder from short fine leg to short midwicket, opening up the gap for that shot
flighted ball on middle and leg, driven to long-on
he was trying to cover drive but mis-timed it to the bowler
cut off the back foot to point
tossed up into the right-hander, driven from the crease through midwicket
driven towards sweeper cover for one more
fuller ball outside off stump, Saini drives with good timing and KP dives on the cover boundary but can't prevent four, he got a hand to the ball but it rolled on to the rope. KP Appanna that is
width outside off again and Saini cuts off the back foot behind point
slightly shorter outside off, Mandeep goes back and cuts through point
bowled into the blockhole, the batsman plays it back to the bowler
played off the back foot through midwicket
defended on the back foot close on the off side
played off the back foot towards wide mid-on
played towards backward point where Agarwal fields and throws at the batsman's end, he misses the stumps and concedes an overthrow
that's too short and at McDonald's pace the ball sits up, Mandeep pulls the ball from outside off stump and hits it flat over midwicket
Saini opens the face of the bat while pushing forward and plays the ball to third man
short of a length outside off, Mandeep stays in is crease and square drives through point
defended on the back foot on the off side
played from the crease through point

edged and Gayle at first slip gets the fingertips of one hand on it but can't catch the ball. Mandeep had backed away to slash towards third man but hit the ball with the high part of the bat. Gayle leaped and reached over his head but the ball was just too high
length ball outside off stump, Mandeep plays the cover drive, hitting the ball on the up through the in field to the man in the deep
he was looking to whip the fuller ball through midwicket but got an inside edge behind square leg
Vinay cuts the ball into the right-hander from a good length and cramps Mandeep for room as he tries to swing across the line, gets beaten between bat and body
full and straight, Saini meets the ball with a straight bat and drives past the bowler and all the way to the straight boundary

pushed off the front foot, Saini edges on the bounce to second slip, Kohli moves to his right to pick up with one hand and scores a direct hit at the striker's end. Is Saini run out? He had taken a few steps out and then took his time turning around. He plonked his bat back just in time. They run overthrows off the ricochet
bowled him! McDonald angled the ball from a good length into the left-hander from round the wicket, Marsh played around the delivery, leaving a gap between bat and pad. McDonald found it
played off the back foot in front of point, Mandeep's looked fluent today
length ball just outside off, Marsh waits in his crease and cuts lat towards third man
good length and straight, played from the crease past the bowler
short of a length and Mandeep pulls through square leg
short of a length from round the wicket, Marsh stays back and negotiates the extra bounce and defends on the leg side
the batsman moves towards leg but the bowler follows him, mis-times the pull through square
shot! He backed away to a length ball and cut it from in front of his stumps through point, timed it beautifully
Mandeep backs away to cut a bounce towards third man but gets beaten
length ball slanting into the left-hander from round the wicket, Marsh stays in his crease and plays towards square
played off the pads towards square leg
good length on off and middle, defended on the off side from the crease
length ball on the pads, Mandeep gets inside the line, under the length of the ball and hoists it over the deep backward square leg boundary
defended back to the bowler
good length around off stump, defended on the front foot towards point
length ball angling across the right-hander and Mandeep plays a punch off the back foot wide of mid-off, Tiwary chases and slides to pull it back but his knee was touching the boundary
short of length ball on off stump, defended towards point to end the over
short of length and well outside off, Marsh is drawn towards it but then withdraws his bat
short of length ball outside off, cracked powerfully behind point for a boundary, Marsh is strong on that shot
short of length ball heading for off, tapped towards midwicket for a quick single
full ball outside off, Marsh swings at it and edges it towards third man for a single
this time he gets bat on it, and gets a boundary as well, not too convincing though, off the leading edge and loops over backward point, third man can't get across in time
charged down the track to that short of length ball but he is beaten
short of length ball, defended from the crease towards cover
shortish ball is pulled towards deep backward square leg for a four, two bounces and past the boundary
slanting across and Mandeep, who flirts with that one but is beaten
on to the pads as Marsh looks to work the ball to the leg side, pops past second slip
starts with a wide down the leg side, de Villiers can't collect that as it slants away
